title: Solution Architect & TechLead (w/m/d) - 3D-SaaS und AWS
description:
Wir suchen Dich!

Als Solution Architect & Tech Lead (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die Architektur unserer 3D-SaaS-Plattform InfraCloud und entwickelst Lösungen für die digitale Inspektion und das Asset-Management von Bauwerken. Du übersetzt Produktanforderungen in technische Konzepte, leitest das Entwicklungsteam fachlich und bringst Dich auch selbst in die Softwareentwicklung ein.

Verstärke unser Team in Vollzeit an unserem Standort in Hamburg oder arbeite remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Die Position ist unbefristet; Deine Arbeitszeit gestaltest Du flexibel innerhalb eines Kollaborationsfensters von 8:00 bis 19:00 Uhr deutscher Zeit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Solution-Architektur von InfraCloud und übersetzt Produktanforderungen in technische Designs, Datenmodelle, API-Verträge und Integrationskonzepte.

  • Du entwickelst die Architektur der 3D-Pipeline und der mobilen Field-App weiter – einschließlich Performance, Skalierbarkeit, Offline-Synchronisation und Konfliktbehandlung.

  • Du konzipierst Integrationen mit Kunden- und Partnersystemen, etwa GIS-Plattformen und Sensordiensten, und gestaltest die sichere Einbindung von KI- und LLM-Funktionen.

  • Du führst das Entwicklungsteam fachlich, begleitest Design- und Code-Reviews, unterstützt Releases und arbeitest bei Sicherheitsfragen und Infrastrukturbedarfen mit dem Security-Team und dem AWS Managed Service Provider zusammen.

  • Du entwickelst rund 30–40 % Deiner Arbeitszeit selbst Prototypen und kritische Komponenten, behebst bei Bedarf Produktionsprobleme und treibst Testautomatisierung sowie technische Qualität voran.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens acht Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, davon mindestens drei Jahre in einer Architektur- oder Tech-Lead-Rolle für ein B2B-SaaS-Produkt; Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung ohne disziplinarische Verantwortung und sicherer Umgang mit Scrum.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Application Security, Secure Coding sowie Authentifizierung und Autorisierung, etwa OWASP Top 10, OIDC, RBAC und MFA; Erfahrung mit Threat Modeling und der Behebung von Schwachstellen.

  • AWS-Kenntnisse auf Anwendungsebene, insbesondere EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, S3 und RDS; Kenntnisse in Terraform und GitLab CI/CD sowie Praxis im Lesen, Reviewen und Schreiben von JavaScript und TypeScript.

  • Erfahrung mit 3D- und Geodaten, etwa 3D Tiles, Meshes, Punktwolken, Photogrammetrie oder GIS-Integration; sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit Offline-first-Architekturen, KI- und LLM-Integration, Testautomatisierung oder Observability; Deutschkenntnisse und Berührungspunkte mit Bauwerksprüfung, Vermessung, Bauingenieurwesen oder Hydrographie.Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwarearchitektur und der Leitung von Entwicklungsteams mit.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python)
description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE

At Zattoo, we bring linear TV to the internet and make it personal for millions of viewers across Europe. Many TV platforms, our own and those of our B2B partners, run on the same backend. The backend team builds and runs the services behind all of them.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll design and run the Python services and APIs that keep this experience fast and reliable, including at peak times like live sports finals. You'll work on a multi-tenant, distributed platform, so scalability, efficiency and maintainability matter in every design decision. You'll also help us keep improving the platform and the way we build it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Shape our API platform. Learn our multi-tenant, distributed web API infrastructure and help take it to the next level.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE

You will build Laelaps end to end: the Command Centre server that operators use to run fleets of autonomous security robots, and the services on the robot that execute missions and report back. You will own features from the API down to the robot and back, and you will solve the algorithmic problems that sit in between.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

  • Mission and tasking: turning an operator instruction into work for one or many robots across sites, and tracking it to completion

  • Robot-side services that stream telemetry, health, events and evidence to the Command Centre over links that drop out

  • Backend services and APIs behind the operator application, and the frontend where a feature needs it

  • Algorithms for patrol routes, task assignment, coordinate frames and event association

  • Making it all run unsupervised in the field

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • A generalist who is equally at home on a server and on a robot

  • Strong in algorithms and data structures, and able to reason about complexity under real constraints

  • Owns problems end to end and ships

YOUR BACKGROUND

  • 4+ years building production software, on both backend and systems or embedded side

  • Strong Python and one of C++, Rust or Go; TypeScript for the frontend is a plus

  • Linux, networking, distributed systems basics; experience with unreliable networks or edge devices

  • Competitive programming, olympiad or equivalent algorithmic depth is a strong signal</

For 26 years, SchemeServe has helped transform insurance products into successful, profitable solutions.

We’re always looking for new ways to innovate and improve. We strive to challenge industry norms and bring a unique personality to our work.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity
description:
About the team:

The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp.

We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter.

We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.

 

What you'll do:

  • Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems.
  • Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users.
  • Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers.
  • Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact preferences with confidence.
  • Work with a talented distributed team that values collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Enjoy your work! We are looking for someone to be paid to do what they love.

 

You'll be great for this role if you have:

  • Experience in backend or fullstack development, primarily with Go. Familiarity with other languages like TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, or Swift is a big plus and can be helpful for working across different systems.

Wir suchen einen serviceorientierten DevOps Engineer, der uns bei der Inbetriebnahme und dem Betrieb unserer Linux-basierten IT-Systeme unterstützt. Du wirst technische Fähigkeiten, eine Leidenschaft für Problemlösungen und die Fähigkeit benötigen, um skalierbare Systeme innerhalb eines agilen Umfelds zu betreiben. Wir erwarten nicht, dass du alles bereits perfekt beherrschst, aber solide Kenntnisse in containerisierten Systemen und die Bereitschaft, neue Technologien zu lernen, sind essenziell.

  • Einrichtung und Betrieb von CI/CD-Werkzeugen (GitLab CI/CD-Pipelines)

Qualifikation

  • Umfangreiche Kenntnisse im Bereich Open Source (OSS) Infrastrukturen und Linux-Systeme

description:
About us

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About the team

The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents.

Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services.

All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down.

The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on-call.

We’re looking for a Tech Lead to join the Funnel Platform team.

You’ll lead the team behind the shared services and frameworks that iwoca’s engineers build on. Those engineers are your customers, and the shared backend services feed iwoca’s lending decisions.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
description:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system.


What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d):

German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.


  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

About us

Trigger.dev is the platform for running reliable AI agents and workflows. Developers use it to build, deploy, and scale production systems with built-in tools for orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and debugging.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users’ code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. Today, we serve thousands of teams building AI apps and agents, handling hundreds of millions of executions per month.

About the role

You’ll own security at Trigger.dev: our infrastructure, our app, the runtime that runs our users’ code, and the secrets they trust us with.

Some of our customers let their own users run code on Trigger.dev (think coding agents running whatever instructions they’re given). That code must never reach our systems or our customers’ systems. Keeping it contained is a feature we ship, so this is a product engineering role as much as a security one.

About half to three quarters of your time will be backend engineering. The rest is hunting for problems and fixing them. When you find something, you own the fix. You’ll set your own priorities and work with others when necessary.

We’re looking for an application security (AppSec) engineer who builds: a senior backend engineer who brings a security mindset to everything they ship.

What you’ll do

  • Sandbox and runtime security. Design and harden the environments that isolate untrusted user code. This is the core of the role.

  • Security features for customers. Build things like end-to-end encrypted secrets, log redaction, private networking, and runtime hardening.

  • Automated offensive testing. Use AI tools to attack our own systems on a schedule, find weak spots, and fix them. Bring in outside pen testers when it’s worth it.

  • Detection and response. Build monitoring and alerting for suspicious activity, improve our security observability, and lead the response when something needs a look.

  • Vulnerability management. Run scanning and triage, own our vulnerability disclosure program, and handle incoming reports.

  • Automated quality. Own our security PR reviews, automated scans, fixes, and triage.

  • Write it down. Document how we do security so the rest of the team can answer customer questions with confidence.

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

About the Role

Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline.

We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to own multiple initiatives across our customer programs and lead the forward deployed engineers working on them. You will work directly with U.S. government and military customers to understand the mission, decide what our C2 and onboard autonomy software can deliver, and set the technical plan to get it into the field. You will make the feasibility calls, keep everyone involved working from the same plan, and make sure your initiatives are ready for the releases that put new capability in operators' hands.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, debug systems in the field, and be on site when the work goes live.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own multiple initiatives within a customer program, from early requirements through deployment. Turn mission needs into a technical roadmap for each one, and make the feasibility and tradeoff calls across them.

  • Lead the forward deployed engineers working on your initiatives by setting technical direction, breaking down the work, and clearing blockers.

  • Write and integrate C2 and onboard autonomy software for unmanned air and sea vehicles, and debug it in the field when something breaks.

  • Participate in and lead design reviews for your initiatives before work starts.

  • Run post-incident reviews after field issues, find the root cause, and put fixes in place so the same problem does not happen again.

  • Bring field data and lessons learned back to the core product team.

  • Work with partner teams to align on priorities and timelines, gather their feedback, and run internal testin

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO (Tech & Strategic Projects)
description:
At Vicoland, we give the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies, in short: “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). Enabled through our unique AI-driven SaaS platform, Vicos allow freelance experts to team up and act like a real company, competing successfully for large enterprise projects.

Our Vicos are already transforming how professional services projects are done. Since our launch 1.5 years ago, Vicos won projects from large corporate clients such as Mercedes-Benz, Netflix, or the German Federal Government, as well as from many mid-sized businesses. Vicoland was mentioned by Forbes and Forrester as a leading force in the market.

Our SaaS platform is an integrated solution of marketing, organizational, legal and financial tech. It includes a marketplace that matches clients and Vicos. It is integrated into the world’s leading procurement software provided by one of our partners, SAP.

There are already 100+ Vicos on our platform, uniting thousands of freelancers. Our central team has 40 members and is located across Europe, expanding to the US. Our headquarters are in Frankfurt/Main.

Our offer to you

You’ll be the CEO’s tech-savvy right hand for AI-centric strategic projects with measurable business impact. From day one, you’ll scope, launch, and deliver cross-functional initiatives aimed at shaping strategy, building operating muscle, and turning ideas into shipped outcomes. You’ll work directly with the CEO and collaborate closely with Product, Software Development, and Partnerships team members. We operate hybrid: regular on-site collaboration in Frankfurt am Main with the CEO (e.g., on key project days) while retaining flexibility to work remotely or from one of our offices (Frankfurt, Walldorf, Barcelona, Seville). Clear career perspectives into Strategy & Partnerships, Product, or Operations leadership as you prove impact.

Tasks

  • Drive CEO special projects end-to-end: define problem statements, scope work, set milestones, coordinate stakeholders & team members, and deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Establish AI-first workflows (e.g., agentic automations, data pipelines) together with Product/Software Development to improve Vico operations and our platform.
  • Pilot and operationalize the “AI agent” role inside Vicos; document learnings and scale playbooks.
  • Support partnerships exploration: research targets, prepare outreach materials, analyze strategic fit, and help bootstrap pilot collaborations.
  • Prepare crisp analyses and decision memos for the CEO (market scans, business cases, OKRs) and track execution against company priorities.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional sprints that translate strategy into product/operations changes; ensure risks, dependencies, and comms are managed

title: Senior Software Engineer, Visual Optimization (Backend focused)
description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

The Mission:

Every great trip starts with a photo that makes someone say, “I need to be there.” As part of our Visual Optimization team, you’ll build the platform behind that moment, owning how millions of images and videos travel from upload to a traveler’s screen. That spans scalable storage on S3, fast transformation and delivery via Cloudflare, foundations for video at scale, ranking and recommendation systems that learn from image performance, moderation and quality models that keep our inventory clean and compliant, and the self-serve APIs, events and tools that make it easy for teams across GetYourGuide to use our services. Your work directly shapes how travelers discover and evaluate experiences through visuals, how much they engage, and how often they book. If you want to solve real scale challenges where infrastructure, data, and ML meet a product people love, this is your next adventure.

Your toolkit

  • 6+ years of software development experience working with distributed systems or search engines.

  • Experience designing and deploying large-scale distributed systems

  • Experience with building reliable and observable systems

  • Mature judgment in choosing when and how to use AI tools, proactively lead the team in adopting and evaluating new AI technologies, and support others in applying AI effectively while maintaining strong standards for quality, security, and governance.

  • Ability to prioritize and manage stakeholders; known for good communication and collaboration skills.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Computer Vision & Machine Learning

  • Erfahrung mit synthetischen Daten, 3D/CAD oder Kamerakalibrierung

title: Hyperscaler & Systems Integrator Partner Manager (North America)
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: Eleve

title: Staff Software Engineer - Payment Processing

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

As a Staff Engineer (Payment Processing) at Checkout.com, you will set the technical direction for our Gateway, Routing and Payout platforms. Every payment and payout we process passes through these systems, from the merchant's API request to the routing decision that sends it to the right acquirer, payment method or payout rail. Correctness matters on every transaction, and small changes in availability, latency or routing quality show up directly in our merchants' approval rates and revenue.

This is a role for engineers who are energised by scale and by the hard trade-offs that come with it: latency budgets on the authorisation path, failure domains and blast radius, consistency and idempotency across regions, and the operational reality of running critical infrastructure around the clock.

You will operate as a force multiplier across multiple teams - shaping architecture, raising the engineering bar, and turning ambiguous, business-critical problems into designs that can be delivered incrementally. We're looking for individuals with deep technical judgement, strong ownership, and a pragmatic approach to breaking big problems into smaller iterations that deliver value continuously.

title: Software Engineer - Delta Platform
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on.

Who we're looking for

Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow.

Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism.

Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming.

 

What you'll do

Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of:

  • Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD.

  • Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems.

  • ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software.

About Antithesis

We take cutting edge software-testing technologies and make them useful for finding real bugs in our customer’s software, allowing them to make more reliable software and ship with confidence.

Historically we’ve focused on the hardest testing problems, providing deterministic simulation testing of whole distributed systems, finding and helping people to understand bugs that would have been a nightmare to find in production.

As more and more code is written by agents, everyone is starting to realise just how important software verification is, and we’re in the process of expanding the problems and companies we target, and are providing an increasingly broad suite of open source and commercial testing tools for a much wider variety of problems and audiences.

We’re well funded, deeply technical, and committed to improving the quality of software across the board. If you’d like to help us do that, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

You'd be joining a small London-based team building out a new Antithesis product, focusing on a more downmarket and diverse set of customers than our main product. We’re rapidly iterating and expect to be shipping some time early in the new year.

We're looking for an engineer at the Senior to Staff level to help us make that system dependable. This will be “devops” in the traditional sense, though more dev than ops: You'll be a member of the engineering team, not a separate operations function, working in the same repository as everyone else, but your primary area of responsibility will be how the system runs in production. That means AWS, deployment, observability, alerting, and the on-call that comes with them.

There will be some on-call, shared with the rest of the team, and part of the job will be helping us define how that works. This is the first product Antithesis is shipping primarily out of the UK, and we want to get things right from the start to make it sustainable and quiet. We’re thinking of this role as less about being the person that gets paged, and more being the person who tries to make sure that nobody does.

Likely much of this will have already been prototyped by the time you join, but there will be a lot of latitude to make big changes to how that works.

What You'll Do

  • Define and build out our observability and alerting

description:
Remote von überall auf der Welt, direkt an der Seite von zwei Gründern, die schon über 20 Firmen aufgebaut haben.

Über uns

Wir bauen Firmen um Menschen herum, die eine gute Idee haben und sie selbst vorantreiben wollen. Unsere beiden Gründer sind Venture-Architekten: Sie bringen Kapital, Vertrieb, Administration und die richtigen Leute zusammen, die Gründer der neuen Firmen bringen Idee und Antrieb. So sind schon über 20 Firmen entstanden, von Pet-Tech über E-Commerce und Einkaufsdienstleistungen bis zu Software für Anwälte. Zusammen beschäftigt die Gruppe weltweit eine dreistellige Zahl an Mitarbeitern.

Unser Ziel ist eine Maschine, die aus jeder guten Idee eine erfolgreiche Firma macht, die ohne die beiden läuft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die diese Maschine mit aufbaut. Von wo aus du das tust, ist uns egal.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du machst aus unserer Arbeitsweise Prozesse. Vieles steckt heute in den Köpfen der beiden Gründer: wie wir mit Gründern arbeiten, wie wir Firmen aufsetzen, wie Reporting läuft. Du schaust es dir an, schreibst es auf und baust daraus klare Abläufe.
  • Du baust ein System, über das die Gründer unserer Firmen regelmäßig berichten.
  • Du prüfst neue Ideen am Markt: Du führst viele Kaltakquise-Telefonate, holst ehrliches Feedback ein und hilfst schnell zu entscheiden, ob aus einer Idee eine Firma wird.
  • Du managst die Termine der beiden Gründer und buchst Flüge und Reisen.
  • Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben, die auf Deutsch erledigt werden müssen.

title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
 
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 
 
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

About the Job
 
The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines, across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency.
 
To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment.
 
 

What you will do
Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems
 
  • Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions

title: Solutions Engineer

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

This is a generalist engineering role, encompassing core software engineering, customer implementation, and solution design. title: Senior Java Engineer (all genders)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Deine Aufgabe ist es, moderne, cloud-native Java-Anwendungen für unsere Kund:innen zu entwickeln und weiterzuentwickeln. Du bringst Deine Erfahrung ein, um hohe Codequalität sicherzustellen und unsere Software-Engineering-Praktiken auf das nächste Level zu heben. Hier ein kurzer Überblick: 
​

  • Als Senior Java Engineer (all genders) entwickelst Du skalierbare, sichere und wartbare Backend-Anwendungen und Microservices in der Cloud (z.B. AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Du übersetzt fachliche und technische Anforderungen in passende Lösungen und setzt diese hands-on um, mit Java, Spring Boot und modernen Software-Design-Prinzipien.
  • Du entwickelst und integrierst Schnittstellen, zum Beispiel REST-APIs, und achtest auf robuste, performante Systeme.
  • Du arbeitest mit CI/CD-Pipelines und Container-Technologien, um Anwendungen gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleg:innen automatisiert und zuverlässig in Produktion zu bringen.
  • Im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kund:innen berätst Du zu Entwicklungsfragen, zeigst Lösungswege auf und unterstützt bei der Modernisierung bestehender Java-Anwendungen für die Cloud.
  • Du teilst Dein Wissen im Team, unterstützt Kolleg:innen durch Code Reviews und Pairing und treibst die technische Weiterentwicklung voran.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, davon mindestens vier Jahre mit Java.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Java und Spring Boot und hast Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung von Microservices und REST-APIs.
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit mindestens einer der großen Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS, Microsoft Azure oder GCP bringst Du mit. 
  • Mit Infrastructure as Code, vorzugsweise Terraform, CI/CD, Container-Technologien und modernen Software-Development-Prozessen kennst Du Dich aus.
  • Strukturiertes, ergebnisorientiertes Arbeiten mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch sowie ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung zeichnen Dich aus. 
  • Teamarbeit ist für Dich selbstverständlich und Du bringst Dich gerne aktiv ein.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)- Certil
description:
Du baust LLM-Anwendungen, die im Unternehmensalltag funktionieren, nicht nur in der Demo. Und Du bleibst dran, bis sie beim Kunden stabil laufen.

Zwischen einer beeindruckenden KI-Demo und einer Anwendung im Unternehmensalltag liegt viel Arbeit. Genau dort setzt certil an: Wir entwickeln eine Plattform, mit der Unternehmen KI-gestützte und agentische Anwendungen kontrolliert einsetzen können. Quellen, Rechenwege und menschliche Entscheidungen werden nachvollziehbar. Ergebnisse lassen sich nachrechnen, und Menschen prüfen sie und entscheiden offene Fragen verantwortlich.

Bei certil heißt der Bereich, der aus Strategie konkrete Use Cases beim Kunden macht, Forward Engineering. Er umfasst die ganze Kette: Use Case, Konzept, Prototyp, erstes Produkt und Betrieb, gemessen auf jeder Stufe. Der erste Use Case läuft, weitere folgen. Als Forward Deployed Engineer übernimmst Du zuerst Bau und Einführung beim Kunden und betreust mittelfristig ganze Use Cases eigenverantwortlich.

Aufgaben

Was Du bei uns machst

  • Use Cases zuschneiden: Gemeinsam mit dem Kunden echte Fälle von Hand durchrechnen und messen, ob sich der Use Case lohnt

  • Expertenwissen übersetzen: Die Arbeitsweise von Fachexpert:innen in prüfbare Schritte zerlegen: Dokumente lesen, rechnen, entscheiden

  • Selbst bauen: Vom Prototyp zum ersten produktiven Stand, mit Coding Agents und testgetrieben

  • Einführen und stabilisieren: Den Use Case beim Kunden einführen und so weit stabilisieren, dass manuelle Kontrollschritte wegfallen

  • Zurückspielen: Wiederverwendbare Bausteine an unser Plattform-Team geben, damit der nächste Use Case schneller geht

Nicht passend für Dich, wenn …

  • Du in den letzten zwei Jahren nicht mehr selbst programmiert hast, etwa weil Du in einer reinen Architektur-, Management- oder Beraterrolle warst,

  • Deine LLM-Erfahrung aus Demos oder Hackathons stammt und nie bei echten Nutzer:innen im Einsatz war,

  • Du bisher nur nach Ticket umgesetzt hast, ohne direkten Kontakt zu Kunden oder Fachabteilungen,

  • Du am liebsten bei Demo, Proof of Concept oder Konzept aufhörst und den Rest an andere übergibst.

Qualifikation

Was Du mitbringst

  • Mehrere Jahre Softwareentwicklung, sicher in Python und TypeScript, und Du programmierst aktuell selbst

  • Du hast LLM-Anwendungen über den Prototyp hinaus gebracht, mit gemessener Qualität, z. B. in Extraktion, Klassifikation oder Evaluation

  • Coding Agents wie Claude Code, Cursor oder Codex gehören zu Deinem Arbeitsalltag

  • Du hast direkt mit Kunden oder Fachabteilungen gearbeitet und Anforderungen selbst erhoben

  • Deutsch fließend, Englisch sicher

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.

It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades.   • Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use

  • Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems

title: UI Engineer (Based in CA or NC only)
description:
Mission: Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security.

The role

Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina

You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them.

The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?).

This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3–5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. The title says UI, but the work doesn’t stop there: you’ll work closely with our backend services, and a feature is finished when it’s proven working live, not when the screen looks right.

Working with design delivered as code

At BlueRock, product designers design and collaborate in code. Instead of handing off static mockups, they build working UI with AI coding tools, against real data, and open merge requests. Iteration happens so quickly that it has outpaced our capacity for robust engineering collaboration and review.

This role closes that gap. You will collaborate directly with product designers and backend developers to keep UI development fast, by bridging the gap between vibe code and high-quality, sustainable, well-tested code. Some days that means reviewing and hardening a designer's branch so it can merge. Other days it means building the shared components, tests and guardrails that make the next branch need less hardening.

Beyond reviewing and hardening code, you'll help shape how it gets made. Working with designers and the AI tools

description:
At Montu UK, we are passionate about improving the lives of patients who have often exhausted conventional treatment options. Through our Alternaleaf clinic, we are helping people living with chronic and debilitating conditions access treatments that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life.

We are looking for Consultant Anaesthetists who are interested in exploring the growing field of medical cannabis and developing their expertise in chronic pain management.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing healthcare organisation, working alongside a multidisciplinary team of experienced clinicians who share a passion for improving patient outcomes.

With a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management and comprehensive specialist training, we are keen to hear from consultants who are open to exploring new approaches to patient care and want to make a meaningful difference in an evolving area of medicine.

Previous chronic pain experience is not essential. What matters is a genuine interest in learning, an open-minded approach to alternative treatment options and a commitment to delivering excellent patient care.

What is the job?

As a Consultant Anaesthetist at Montu, the role focuses on assessing and supporting patients living with chronic pain who may have exhausted conventional treatment options.

Working within our Alternaleaf clinic, consultants play a central role in determining the suitability of cannabis-based prescription medicines (CBPMs), developing individualised treatment plans and supporting patients throughout their treatment journey.

The position offers the opportunity to build on existing expertise in analgesic pharmacology, pain management and opioid stewardship while developing specialist knowledge in an evolving area of medicine.

Our multidisciplinary approach brings together consultants, nurses, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient care.

Sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management

As part of our commitment to clinical development, Montu is offering a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales, delivered fully online in partnership with Learna.

The programme provides an opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in chronic pain management while continuing to gain practical clinical experience within our multidisciplinary team.

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

Agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will lead the team building ours.

You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful. That tension — airtight isolation, at fleet scale, at low latency — is the product.

Your customers are the people building the next generation of AI software on our infrastructure; the primitives you ship become the runtime their agents live in.

description:

title: Manufacturing Systems Engineer
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.


About the role

We are looking for a manufacturing systems engineer to own the production process and make it ready for a significant scaleup. You will work closely with our engineering and production team in Zürich to make our production more reliable and scalable.


This role is very hands-on and you will spend a lot of your time on the shop floor solving issues and improving production hand in hand with assembly technicians. You will be building out a world class production system to support a rapidly growing supply base.   


What you will do

  • Own how our product is built from start to finish

  • Create and maintain production process documentation, both for internal and external manufacturing

  • Improve workstation layout, flow design and tooling from incoming goods to product shipping

  • Support make vs buy decisions and supplier selection

  • Support new product introduction from development to production

  • Close DFM feedback loop to improve manufacturability


    • What we're looking for

  • A university degree in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics Engineering or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years experience in manufacturing / process engineering in mid volume manufacturing

  • Taken a product from prototype to repeatable series production before

  • CAD knowledge for designing fixtures and reviewing designs

title: Developer Community Lead
description:
About RhymeQ

RhymeQ is on a mission to make quantum programmable for every developer. Today, developing quantum software often requires deep physics expertise and code tailored to specific hardware. We’re removing these barriers so developers can focus on solving problems.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, we bring together an international team with an open mindset, an energetic team spirit, and a shared drive to build something that matters. We value initiative, ownership, and collaboration, giving everyone the space to contribute ideas, take responsibility, and help shape the future of quantum programming.

Your role

As our Developer Community Lead, you will help developers discover, write their first quantum program, and keep building. Your goal is to turn early interest into an active community where developers learn from one another, share projects, and contribute to the product’s development.

You will combine technical education, community building, and developer outreach. Working closely with our founders and engineering team, you will shape the community experience and grow the community internationally to our target size.

What you will do

  • Grow an active developer community: Build relationships with universities, programming communities, quantum organizations, and event organizers to attract developers to RHYME.
  • Help newcomers succeed: Create a clear onboarding journey, from registration and installation to running and sharing a first quantum program.
  • Build reasons to return: Organize onboarding cohorts, office hours, coding challenges, and hackathons that encourage continued learning and participation.
  • Create useful technical content: Develop tutorials, sample projects, livestreams, posts, and talks that make quantum programming approachable.
  • Support community contributions: Encourage developers to share their work, answer questions, and help others. Identify and support potential community ambassadors.
  • Connect developers with the product team: Turn questions, feedback, and recurring problems into clear recommendations for the compiler, tooling, and documentation.
  • Measure what works: Track acquisition, activation, retention, and contributions, and use the results to improve community programs.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s in computer science, PhD is preferred.
  • Over 2 years of experience growing a developer community for a technical product, with results you can demonstrate through active users, downloads, contributors, event participation, or other relevant measures.
  • Practical Python skills. You can run code examples, lead a live tutorial, and help a newcomer troubleshoot their setup.
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and make learning engaging, whether in writing, on camera, or on stage.
  • Strong written and spoken English and confidence working with an internation

title: Enterprise Account Executive - English
Research Engineer - Cybersecurity (RL Environments)
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Cybersecurity is one of the areas where AI could do the most good — and one where the capability must be built with particular care. As a Research Engineer on this track, you'll push our models' capabilities in vulnerability discovery and remediation, security analysis, incident response, and across the offensive-to-defensive spectrum of cybersecurity, and it will be your job to develop that ability deliberately and safely.

The work sits at the meeting point of research and engineering: you'll devise new approaches and be the one to implement them. Concretely, that means designing and building RL environments that reproduce realistic security scenarios, pipelines that generate synthetic training instances at scale, and experiments and evaluations that show what our models can actually do. Your results feed directly into the production training runs that shape our frontier models, in close collaboration with Mistral's researchers, engineers, and security specialists.

Security specialists and ML engineers are both welcome here — what matters is that you can hold your own in both worlds, and are eager to go deeper on the one you know less.

What You Will Do

  • Design and implement RL environments simulating cybersecurity scenarios.

  • Build the pipelines and infrastructure that generate synthetic cybersecurity training instances at scale — thousands of scenarios, not one hand-crafted exercise.

  • Conduct experiments and evaluations of model capabilities on these environments, from quick prototypes to controlled benchmark runs.

  • Own the infrastructure behind the environments: containers, sandboxes, VMs, cloud deployments, and orchestration (Kubernetes), all managed as code.

title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React
description:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD
  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit
  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote
  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)
  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden
  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen
  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen
  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln
  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen
  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden
  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)
  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)
  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID
  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework
  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

title: Product Engineer KI-first (m/w/d) - Full Stack, 100 % remote
description:
In unserem Portal bereiten mittelständische Unternehmen ihren Antrag bei der Bescheinigungsstelle Forschungszulage vor. Sie erfassen dort Projektzeiten und Kosten, laden ihre Unterlagen hoch und arbeiten mit unseren Beratern aus ihrer Entwicklungsarbeit ein förderfähiges Vorhaben heraus. Das Portal läuft, Mandanten arbeiten damit, und es hat noch viel vor sich.

Dafür suchen wir die Person, die es verantwortet. Sie haben schon einmal eine produktive Anwendung weitgehend allein getragen und wollen das wieder tun. Sie entscheiden mit, was als Nächstes entsteht, und Sie bauen es: Funktionen, Antragsprozess, Oberfläche, Server und Sicherheitsarchitektur. Dabei arbeiten Sie KI-first. Coding-Agenten sind Ihr erstes Werkzeug und nicht Ihr letztes Wort, denn Sie bauen schnell und beweisen dort, wo es zählt, dass es stimmt.

fundloop unterstützt mittelständische Unternehmen dabei, ihre Forschung und Entwicklung zu finanzieren. Sie arbeiten zu 100 Prozent remote, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und zu den Menschen, die mit Ihrem Werkzeug arbeiten.

Aufgaben

Sie entwickeln unser Portal eigenverantwortlich weiter, von der Idee bis zum Betrieb. Im Einzelnen heißt das:

  • Funktionen bauen, die Mandate voranbringen: Sie nehmen auf, woran Berater und Mandanten hängen bleiben, entscheiden mit uns über die Reihenfolge und liefern in kurzen Zyklen aus.

  • Den Antragsprozess weiterentwickeln: Der Weg vom Mandantengespräch bis zum fertigen Antragsentwurf ist bei uns ein geführter, KI-gestützter Ablauf mit fachlichen Prüfschritten. Sie machen ihn treffsicherer und schneller und sorgen dafür, dass er auch bei vielen parallelen Mandaten trägt. Das fachliche Urteil bleibt bei unseren Beratern.

  • Mit Sprachmodellen arbeiten, im Portal und beim Bauen: Sie gestalten Prompts, Agenten und Prüfläufe und messen, ob ein Schritt wirklich besser geworden ist.

  • Die Sicherheitsarchitektur verantworten: Mandantentrennung auf Datenbankebene, Rollen und Rechte, Verschlüsselung, Zwei-Faktor-Anmeldung und Protokollierung. Unsere Mandanten vertrauen uns Personal- und Finanzdaten an. Vor jeder Auslieferung prüft deshalb ein Test die Mandantentrennung, und Sie bauen diese Beweisführung aus.

  • Server und Betrieb führen: Auslieferung, Testumgebung, Datenbankmigrationen, Backups und Überwachung. Sie halten die Umgebung schlank, nachvollziehbar und wiederherstellbar.

  • Oberfläche und Nutzerführung gestalten: Sie sorgen dafür, dass eine Geschäftsführerin oder ein Entwicklungsleiter ohne Schulung durch das Portal kommt. Ein Design-System gibt es bereits.

  • Datenschutz mitdenken: Sie setzen technische und organisatorische Maßnahmen um und entscheiden bei jedem neuen Dienst mit, ob er zu unseren Anforderungen passt.

At machineMD in Bern we’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. title: Strategy & Operations Director
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame.

This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain.

What You'll Work On

  • Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in.

  • Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else.

  • Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures.

  • Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate.

  • Evaluation: held-out sites, night and thermal slices, regression gates. A model that is worse anywhere does not ship.

  • Training machinery: multi-GPU training, data loaders for multi-sensor clips, experiment tracking and reproducible runs.

Who We're Looking For

A research engineer who has shipped multimodal models, not only published them. You know

title: Internship Teleoperation & Data Labeling - Switzerland
description:
Internship – Teleoperation & Data Labeling (m/f/d) – St.
Gallen, Switzerland


Who We Are


We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world—moving
beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our
technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can’t solve. We are on a
mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we’re looking for curious, bold thinkers to
help shape the future of robotics with us.


Overview


We are looking for a tech-savvy intern with a passion for robotics, machine learning, or
computer vision who wants hands-on experience in teleoperation and operating state-of-the-art robots. You will be based at one of our customer sites in St. Gallen, where our robots are
running in live operations. We are growing our team in Switzerland: this position is employed
directly through our Swiss entity based in Zurich. This role is perfect for someone eager to
learn, contribute, and gain practical exposure to advanced AI-driven robotic systems.


Your Responsibilities


• Robot Teleoperation: Collect high-quality data by controlling robots through a VR
headset.
• Data Labeling: Label visual data (images, point clouds) with speed and precision.
• Use terminal basics to run existing tooling (bash + Python scripts) for data collection,
uploads, and checks
• Do simple debugging: reproduce issues, collect logs, and write clear problem reports
(steps, expected vs actual, timestamps, logs/screenshots)
• Collaboration: Work with a fast-paced, innovative tech team, both on site at our
customer and remotely with our engineering team.
• Travel to other sites within Switzerland or the EU may occasionally be required


Your Qualifications


• You pay close attention to detail and enjoy precise, careful work
• You’re comfortable with computers and curious about tech. Some experience with the
command line or Python is a plus, but we’ll teach you what you need
• You stay calm and focused in a fast-moving team
• You’re open to occasional travel
• You are eligible to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss
work permit)
• Nice to have: a driving license valid in Switzerland

Location


• Work location: St. Gallen, Switzerland, on site at our customer, with occasional travel
within Switzerland or the EU
• Employment through our Swiss entity in Zurich


Duration: Minimum 3 months, full-time (40 h/week)

title: Fullstack Software Engineer
iOS Developer - AI Finance Agent
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for Doit's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

title: Strategy & Operations Director
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For
