title: Commercial Account Executive, Growth | Remote | Germany
Senior Product Manager
Account Executive, Mid-Market - DACH
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner wo

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Product und Business Development zur Stärkung der Marktposition von Shopware und zum Ausbau der Pipeline.

title: Strategic Account Executive - Manufacturing
Member of Technical Staff – VM Product & Infra
description:
Your team

You will work with the engineers who build and run the infrastructure behind Lyceum’s VM product. The team’s aim is a platform that operates without manual intervention: VM launches, upgrades and recovery should need no human in the loop, and changes should reach production without customers noticing.

Your mission

You will build and run the infrastructure underneath Lyceum's VM product: the control plane, the scheduling and the host layer. While others on the team add features, your job is to make sure a customer who requests a VM gets one quickly, and that it stays up.

Your focus

Control plane: Build the services that schedule and place VMs across hosts, GPU types and data centres, and manage capacity as the fleet grows.

Host infrastructure: Own the hypervisor hosts and their storage and network backends, and keep them consistent across heterogeneous hardware.

Reliability: Design for host failures, upgrades without customer downtime, and fast recovery. Take part in incident response.

Integration: Connect the VM stack with our provisioning and orchestration layer, so machines can move between products as demand changes.

Your KPIs

  • VM availability and SLA adherence

  • VM launch success rate and time to launch

  • Utilisation of VM capacity

  • Time to recover from host failures

Your profile

We consider candidates from diverse backgrounds, with a deep love for technical challenges and the desire to take on ownership beyond what's reasonably expected.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in systems or infrastructure engineering

  • Strong proficiency in Go and Python

  • Strong fundamentals in Linux, virtualisation, networking and storage

  • Experience building or operating distributed systems or control planes

  • Experience running production infrastructure and troubleshooting it under pressure

Nice to have

  • Experience building an IaaS platform (OpenStack, KubeVirt

title: Founding Customer Success Manager*in
description:
Über uns

Yes ist die Software für Vertriebsteams von FMCG-Marken im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel. Außendienst, Key Account und Vertriebsleitung arbeiten in einem System: Tourenplanung, Storechecks, Aktionen, Ziele und Auswertungen in Echtzeit. Zu unseren Kunden gehören unter anderem nucao, ahead und Uludağ.

Wir sind ein stark wachsendes Early-Stage-Startup. Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung, gestaltest Strukturen und Prozesse mit und arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Die Rolle

Als Founding Customer Success Manager*in verantwortest du bei Yes alles, was nach dem Vertragsabschluss passiert. Du bringst die Teams unserer Kunden produktiv ins System, bleibst danach ihre feste Ansprechperson und legst dabei selbst fest, wie Onboarding, Betreuung und Support bei Yes funktionieren. Du entwickelst die Prozesse dafür von der Onboarding-Strecke über den Support bis zum Reporting. Du berichtest direkt an den COO.

So arbeitest du bei uns

  • Du priorisierst selbst, was als Nächstes dran ist, und holst dir Abstimmung, wenn du sie brauchst, nicht für jeden Schritt.

  • Du findest pragmatische Lösungen, auch wenn Informationen fehlen oder für einen Fall noch kein Prozess existiert.

  • Du gehst Kundenprobleme bis zur Ursache nach, statt sie weiterzugeben, und arbeitest dich dafür auch in die Daten und das Produkt ein.

  • Du wechselst innerhalb eines Tages zwischen Schulung im Markt, Datenimport und Prozessarbeit, ohne den Überblick zu verlieren.

  • Du baust Abläufe beim ersten Mal so, dass sie beim zehnten Kunden noch funktionieren, und dokumentierst sie entsprechend.

  • Du sagst offen, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, und bringst einen Vorschlag mit.

Deine Aufgaben

Onboarding und Implementierung (ca. 50 %)

  • Durchführung von Kickoffs und Onboardings neuer Kunden bis zum Livegang

  • Einrichtung der Kundenaccounts inklusive Nutzer*innen, Gebiete und Integrationen

  • Migration und Import von Kundendaten, zum Beispiel Stammdaten zu Märkten, Produkten und Besuchshistorie aus Excel, ERP- oder Altsystemen

  • Schulungen für Außendienst, Key Account und Innendienst, remote und vor Ort

  • Erstellung von Schulungsmaterial und Help-Center-Artikeln

Kundenbetreuung und Wachstum (ca. 35 %)

  • Betreuung des Kundenportfolios als feste Ansprechperson

  • Monitoring von Nutzung und Account-Health, frühzeitiges Erkennen von Churn-Risiken

  • regelmäßige Business Reviews mit den Vertriebsleitungen unserer Kunden

  • Identifikation und Vorbereitung von Rollouts, Upsells und Vertragsverlängerungen in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung

  • First-Level-Support und Abstimmung technischer Themen mit der Entwicklung

Aufbau und Produktfeedback (ca. 15 %)

  • Aufbau der Customer-Success-Prozes

title: Robot Operator
description:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role

You will be the key connector between the digital and physical world. You will physically guide and remotely operate (teleoperate) state-of-the-art robots using motion-capture systems. Your physical demonstrations will directly form the training data our neural networks use to learn complex, real-world tasks. You will teach the AI what good looks like.

  • Data Capture & Teleoperation: Perform high-volume task demonstrations (e.g., sorting objects, operating tools, door opening, manual assembly, cable manipulation) via motion tracking equipment.

  • Quality Assurance: Monitor data stream quality, tag trajectory metadata, and flag anomalies or edge-case physical behaviors to the AI engineering team.

  • Hardware & Setup Maintenance: Assist with staging environments, changing end-effectors, suggest hardware/software improvements and basic routine maintenance on the robot fleet.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Work directly with AI researchers and robotics engineers to iterate on teleoperation controls and data acquisition pipelines.

What We're Looking For

  • Comfortable piloting various robots for extended duration.

  • Strong hand-eye coordination, spatial awareness, and fine motor control.

  • Attention to Detail: A preference for an organized, functional workspace and a systematic app

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

About the role

This role spans Perception Autonomy, Autonomy Behaviours—including collision avoidance (COLAV), target-based manoeuvring and engagement—and Swarm Intelligence. You will take cross-system initiatives from design and implementation through scenario-based verification, field trials, deployment, and iteration.

The role requires strong software engineering and mathematical foundations, with an emphasis on autonomy that remains safe, observable, and useful in real operating conditions—including degraded sensors, different sea states, and GNSS- or RF-challenged environments.

What you’ll do

  • Build production-grade capabilities across perception, autonomous behaviours, COLAV, and multi-USV coordination.

  • Define measurable acceptance criteria for autonomy performance, safety, reliability, and operator trust.

  • Validate perception and behaviours across day/night operations, different sea states, sensor degradation, and GNSS/RF-challenged conditions.

  • Develop swarm capabilities such as task allocation, role assignment, formation control, and distributed sensing.

  • Build scenario libraries, replay tooling, automated metrics, and CI gates to prevent regressions.

  • Introduce structured logging, playback, and failure classification to accelerate field diagnosis.

  • Build operator controls and safeguards that enable crews to use autonomy without continuous engineering support.

  • Collaborate with platform, C2, product, and field teams to define clear interfaces and deliver cross-system capabilities.

description:
Regional Sales Manager, DACH (m/w/d)

Regional Role · Remote, based in the DACH region · Reports to: Sales Director

About Everfield

Everfield acquires and builds vertical SaaS businesses across Europe. Our portfolio spans more than 40 companies serving niche markets where software is mission-critical. We take a long-term ownership approach: we buy, invest, and build. We don't flip. Seven companies are in DACH, and we expect continuous growth in portfolio size and performance across all regions.

We are building a small, high-impact HQ revenue team responsible for lifting the commercial capability of our portfolio companies: setting standards, identifying risk, and accelerating performance. The role reports to Everfield's Sales Director, who owns consistency of the revenue system across all regions, and works day to day with the region's General Director and the CEOs of its Business Units.

The Opportunity

The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) is a cluster-level revenue operator responsible for improving sales execution and accelerating organic revenue growth across a group of portfolio companies. The role partners directly with CEOs and Business Unit leaders to strengthen pipeline discipline, improve forecast accuracy, and raise commercial maturity across the region.

This is not purely an advisory role. Alongside the regional remit, the RSM is expected to take direct sales management responsibility inside Business Units where that is the fastest route to growth, giving smaller commercial teams access to experienced sales leadership they would not otherwise have. As the region scales, the ambition is that one person can hold the sales management role on behalf of several Business Units at once, applying a standard across all of them.

Success is reflected in improved revenue predictability, stronger pipeline discipline, and sustained bookings growth across Business Units.

How the Role Operates

• Two levels, one standard. The regional remit is constant: diagnostics, pipeline discipline, forecast integrity, and commercial governance across every Business Unit in the cluster. title: Senior Treasury Product Control Analyst

  • You like being part of a team and being helpful to others

  • Curiosity, innovative thinking, and a passion for pushing the boundaries of technology

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the

title: Engineering Manager - Platform and Data Intelligence
description:
Engineering Manager - Platform and Data Intelligence

 
 

About trawa

 

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, and Flex combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings, all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast, the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

 
 
 

About the Role

 

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead two teams that form the foundation everything at trawa runs on: Data Intelligence and Platform.

Data is the heartbeat of trawa. It turns the complexity of energy markets into savings and sustainability for our customers. Underneath it sits the cloud infrastructure powering our services and the IT and security practices that keep our systems and data safe. You’ll own the technical direction for all of it, from metering data management and billing to AWS infrastructure and internal IT.

You’ll shape a team culture grounded in trust, collaboration, and continuous learning, where engineers thrive and do their best work. You’ll report to the Director of Engineering and lead an established, growing group of engineers across two closely related teams.

At trawa, our culture is “office-first with flexibility”: most of us are in our Berlin office the majority of the week, with room to work from home

This is an Atlantic porfolio company.

The opportunity

Demand for AI compute is outrunning the infrastructure to deliver it, and the environmental bill is growing with it: more fossil power, more freshwater, more land. New capacity on land also means waiting years for power, sites and permits.

We take a different route: we bring compute to the power. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on land, and no grid will ever reach it. Using it lets AI scale without adding carbon or competing with communities and nature for water and land.

We're building fleets of autonomous ships that turn that wind into AI compute at sea. Each ship carries its own wind turbines and computing on board, and navigates on its own across the open ocean, following the strongest and steadiest winds. No mooring, no cables to shore: the fleet goes where the energy is. It's AI infrastructure built from the ground up for the open ocean, from power systems and autonomy to high-density computing, engineered to run in one of the harshest environments on Earth. No grid queue. No freshwater. No land. Zero-carbon compute that scales with the fleet.

  • Firm, low-carbon power at a target cost of ~€50/MWh, one of the biggest costs in running AI compute

  • 70%+ capacity factor: offshore wind that behaves like baseload

  • First demonstrator at sea in late 2027

Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs and industrial leaders. Backed by major international investors.

You'll work directly with the CEO and the board and own the company's business strategy as we go from first demonstrator to fleet.

Our platform opens several paths to value across compute and infrastructure, from capacity to hardware to the services around them. You'll decide which to pursue first, build them into the core of the company, and open new ones as the fleet grows.

  • Strategic partnerships. Decide which partners and customers we build the company with, from AI labs and cloud providers to chipmakers and sovereign compute programmes, and secure the relationships that shape our first fleet.

  • Capital strategy. Work with the CEO on how the business case underpins project finance and fundraising, and own that story with investors and the board.

title: Lead Engineer (UK)
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive, London
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

Open to hiring remote in London, UK.

Build the algorithmic core of planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – DACH
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint

title: Senior Backend Engineer(Go), Storage Platform
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

What you'll be doing

As part of Wolt's Platform department (Core Group), you'll help improve and automate operations for our storage access platform - our real time database abstraction layer solution designed with scale and resiliency in mind . The product you will build enforces best practices by design, abstracts database infrastructure, and supports Multi-Region architecture through data sharding and replication. You join a team of highly skilled engineers in designing, building and optimizing this platform and ensuring smooth developer onboarding, constant improvement and optimization. 

As an engineer on the Storage access platform team, you'll work on platform features such as UI for developer teams, storage abstraction layer, database automation, client SDK and proxy, Change Data Capture pipelines, caching and ephemeral storage, Hot & Cold storage management and more.

Our humble expectations

You'll be a great fit for this role if you have the following skills and experience:

  • A strong developer-to-developer mindset, with a genuine enjoyment of building for internal customers and treating other engineers as your primary users.
  • Adaptability and strong motivation for working with distributed systems.
  • A data-driven approach to decision-making and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to navigate disagreements constructively and deliver consistently.
  • Autonomy in dynamic, fast-paced environments with frequent change.
  • A product- and platform-oriented approach to engineering challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • A collaborative spirit and experience contributing to diverse and inclusive work environments.

Technical proficiencies:

  • Expertise in NoSQL databases, particularly Cassandra or DynamoDB.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems, emphasizing both velocity and scalability.
  • Familiarity with SRE principles; however, a background in Backend Development is essenti

title: Strategy & Ops Lead, Applied AI
description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

 

Overview

We are hiring an Applied AI Strategy & Ops Lead to own and evolve our internal tooling ecosystem across Ops. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with real ownership. You’ll work across a range of tools including support platforms, AI-driven systems, and internal automations to improve how our day-to-day operations function.

You'll sit at the intersection of Operations and Engineering, acting as the technical voice of Ops and partner closely with team leadership to execute against defined priorities, refine existing systems, and introduce new tooling where needed ensuring our stack continues to scale effectively with the business.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build and iterate on workflows, integrations, and automations that improve day-to-day efficiency

  • Execute against high-priority tooling and automation initiatives across the operational stack.

  • Improve systems across multiple tools, including support platforms and AI-driven solutions

  • Translate defined problems into practical, well-scoped technical solutions

  • Identify gaps or inefficiencies in current tooling and proactively address them

  • Troubleshoot issues, improve system reliability, and ensure tools perform effectively in production

  • Contribute to ongoing improvements in how our systems connect and operate together

Your Mission

Build the next generation of customer growth at Cosuno.

Cosuno is the AI construction platform connecting the European construction industry. Every day, thousands of construction companies use our platform to find partners, publish tenders, submit bids and win contracts. Über ProviPanda

ProviPanda ist ein wachsendes HR-Tech-Startup aus Hamburg und die größte Sales-Job-Plattform im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 15+ Mitarbeitenden arbeitet daran, den Sales-HR-Markt neu zu denken.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung und operativem Tagesgeschäft. Du arbeitest 1:1 mit dem Gründer, berichtest direkt an ihn und löst Probleme eigenständig, statt sie nur weiterzureichen.

title: Tech Lead - Remote Assist, Robotaxi
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


🛠️ About our Robotaxi Teams

The Robotaxi team is building the capabilities that take Wayve's AI Driver from assisted to fully driver-out operation. Remote Assistance sits at the heart of this effort, the real-time bridge between the vehicle's autonomy stack and human operators that lets us safely handle the moments the AI Driver can't resolve alone. This team owns the end-to-end architecture connecting onboard vehicle systems, offboard services, and operator tooling, balancing latency, reliability, and safety at every step.

  • Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Remote Assistance across onboard integration, offboard services, and operator tooling/HMI

  • Define and drive the vehicle–operator "contract" - covering data, authority bounds, fallback/MRM behaviour, and failure handling

  • Lead cross-team execution across autonomy, safety, platform/infra, and product partners, turning architecture into deliverable workstreams

  • Set system-level quality bars for safety-critical RA operation - latency budgets, reliability targets, monitoring, replay/evidence, and incident learning loops

  • Act as the technical interface to engineering leadership and safety stakeholders, shaping how Remote Assistance feeds into Wayve's evolving L4 safety case

🧩 What you'll be working on:

  • The end-to-end Remote Assistance system onboard vehicle integration, offboard services, and the operator-facing HMI, designed to evolve as one connected system

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Heavy-Duty Automation Engineer on Harmattan AI's Launcher team in Lausanne, you will take a clean-sheet, fully autonomous launch system from a blank sheet of paper to live flight tests by simulation, prototype testing and field testing.

Our Launcher team builds the ruggedized, unmanned deployment infrastructure that takes our larger autonomous platforms from storage to flight at a moment's notice. Operating in a fast-paced startup environment within a tight-knit, cross-functional squad, you will own the entire control, automation, and safety architecture end-to-end.

Your work spans defining system specifications, selecting controllers, sensors, and high-speed valves, managing external suppliers, and getting hands-on programming PLCs, wiring prototypes, and tuning closed-loop characteristics and motion controls in the workshop and field.

  • High-Acceleration & Precision Control: Select, integrate, and tune motion control systems (controllers, sensors, proportional/high-speed valves) capable of managing both high-precision positioning and extreme launch acceleration.

  • Machine Safety & Risk Assessment: Define safety standards, perform risk assessments, and implement hardware/software interlocks and performance levels for high-energy, unmanned outdoor equipment.

title: Director AI Platform Engineering
description:
Our client is building a new AI Engineering & Platform team in Germany to support the next generation of AI-powered media, localization, automation, and workflow capabilities. This is a senior hands-on leadership role for someone who can build and run a high-performing engineering team, deliver complex AI platform and integration projects, and provide technical direction across cloud infrastructure, model deployment, AI services, agentic workflows, and production operations. The role will lead a hybrid engineering team based primarily in Germany while also managing and collaborating with engineers in other our client locations, including the United States.

  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a distributed AI engineering team across Germany and other our client locations. Experience recruiting, hiring, and standing up the full AI/ML engineering organization from scratch: applied ML engineers, MLOps/platform engineers, data engineers, integration engineers, etc.

  • Lead development, hosting and ongoing improvement of our client’s cloud-native training and inference platform (compute, storage, orchestration, model serving, monitoring, cost management) for our client’s NLP technology for MT, ASR, and TTS in production.

  • Own technical delivery for our client’s AI platform, model-serving, workflow automation, and applied AI engineering initiatives.

  • Lead architecture,execution, deployment and SLA performance for scalable AI services, including inference platforms, training environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and operational support.

  • Own infrastructure cost efficiency (GPU utilization, training vs. inference cost trade-offs, autoscaling) as a first-class, ongoing responsibility rather than a one-time setup task.

  • Evaluate internal and external AI technologies on an ongoing basis, including commercial models, open-source models, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and vendor platforms.

title: Image Processing Intern: AI-Assisted Tools for CalVal
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for an intern to join the End-to-End Validation & Performance (EVP) team and contribute to image-processing and calibration/validation (CAL/VAL) activities for Earth-observation missions. In this internship, you’ll explore how AIT captures and routine onboard imagery can support optical performance testing and radiometric calibration, and turn that work into an evaluated engineering prototype.

Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station)
Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027.


About this role:
  • Review DSNU, radiometric calibration, and relevant EVP processing and CAL/VAL practices.
  • Work with EVP engineers to identify suitable routine images, metadata, and reference calibration data; document data limitations and provenance.
  • Prepare a reproducible dataset and establish reference baselines, including a holdout evaluation strategy that avoids tuning and testing on the same acquisitions.
  • Implement a baseline estimator: a data-fit term combined with a regularizing prior.
  • Investigate additional AI/ML methods only where suitable training or validation data are available; compare them against the baseline rather than assuming they are superior.
  • Evaluate correction quality, residual fixed-pattern structure, stability across images, runtime, and failure cases.
  • Package the workflow as a prototype script or notebook with plots, quality checks, and an auditable record of inputs, parameters, and outputs.
  • Present findings and recommendations to EVP and CAL/VAL stakeholders; document what evidence would be needed before operational use.
    • The intern will gain experience in:
    • Radiometric calibration and CAL/VAL for space-based optical imaging.
    • Push-broom image characteristics and PRNU/DSNU correction.
    • Applied optimization and, where appropriate, machine learning for image processing.
    • Experimental design, reference-data limitations, and quantitative performance assessment.
    • Building reproducible engineering tools and communicating technical evidence to mission teams.

Must Haves:
  • Student in engineering, applied physics, remote sensing, image processing, data science, or a related field.
  • Fundamentals of signal or image processing and a strong interest in Earth observa

title: (Junior-) Vertriebsmitarbeiter KI-Lösungen (m/w/d)

Du findest KI spannend, aber noch spannender, was Unternehmen damit im Alltag wirklich anfangen können? Du redest gern mit Menschen, erkennst schnell, wo in einem Betrieb Zeit liegen bleibt, und willst einen Kunden vom ersten Anruf bis zur Unterschrift selbst begleiten? Dann passt du zu uns.

Ob Berufseinsteiger oder erfahrener Vertriebler: Wichtiger als die Zahl deiner Berufsjahre ist uns, dass du neugierig bist, zuhörst und ehrlich berätst. Du musst kein Entwickler sein. Wie unsere Plattform funktioniert, lernst du bei uns, mit den Leuten, die sie gebaut haben.

Wir sind MintCode Solutions aus Haselünne, ein Team aus 8 Leuten. Neben klassischer IT-Infrastruktur haben wir Nexus entwickelt: eine KI-Plattform, die komplett auf lokaler Hardware beim Kunden läuft. Nexus ersetzt kein ERP und keine andere Software, sondern dockt an die vorhandenen Systeme an. Betriebe automatisieren damit ihre eigenen Abläufe, von der Belegerfassung aus E-Mails über die Angebotserstellung bis zur Wissensdatenbank.

Aufgaben

  • Du erschließt dein eigenes Kundengebiet für Nexus und bist dafür verantwortlich.

  • Du betreust deine Kunden vollständig selbst, von der Kaltakquise bis zur finalen Unterschrift: Es gibt keine Übergabe an einen anderen Vertriebler

  • Du baust den Vertrieb für unsere KI-Plattform mit auf

  • Du planst selbst, welche Unternehmen du in deinem Gebiet ansprichst, und gehst aktiv auf sie zu, per Telefon, über LinkedIn, auf Veranstaltungen und über dein Netzwerk

  • Du zeigst Nexus in Demos, online und vor Ort, und erklärst es so, dass auch Nicht-Techniker den Nutzen verstehen

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Technikern die passende Lösung und erstellst das Angebot

  • Du fasst nach, verhandelst und holst die Unterschrift

title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
description:
Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team.

Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers.

  • Provide training and guidance to colleagues across the organisation, helping non-legal teams understand their responsibilities when handling personal data.

What They're Looking For

  • A qualified lawyer with approximately 4-10 years experience specialising in data protection, privacy or technology law, gained in private practice, in-house or a combination of both.

  • Strong knowledge of GDPR and European data protection law, including regulatory guidance and its practical application within commercial organisations.

  • Experience advising technology business

title: Defense Success Manager, France
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Defense Success Manager, you own what happens to our most strategic defense and sovereign accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows — often in restricted or disconnected environments — keep production commitments healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals that Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep — typically one or two flagship accounts plus a small number of adjacent programs. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex and constrained deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Switzerland.

Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

title: Senior Engagement Manager - Professional Services Sales,  EMEA
Customer Success Architect, France
Rust Product Engineer – MLS (m/f/d)
description:
Do you want to bring modern end-to-end encryption to people who rely on it every day? Then we're looking for you as a Rust Product Engineer - MLS (m/f/d) on our MLS team!

We're bringing Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) to secure messaging for the German public sector. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet.

We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates.

How we work:

  • Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies.
  • Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations.
  • AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs.
  • Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them.


Your responsibilities:

  • Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions.
  • Decide with your team and our partners where a change belongs: the SDK, the server, or a spec proposal.
  • Build and run server-side MLS components in Rust, including message delivery, the Matrix integration and federation between servers.
  • Ship your work to production yourself, including in our customer's environments.
  • Contribute to spec proposals where they affect what we build.
  • Improve our agent workflows and share what you learn.


What you should bring:

  • At least three years of experience with Rust in production, including async Rust (Tokio or similar).
  • You already work with coding agents every day and have your own workflows for them.
  • Sharp judgment in code review: you notice when generated code looks plausible but is wrong, for example a race in message ordering or an error path that silently loses state.
  • Experience with distributed systems or network protocols: ordering, consistency, failure modes.
  • You can read an RFC and turn it into code and tests.
  • You enjoy writing: specs, decision records, review comments.

title: HR Leitung mit Fokus Recruiting (m/w/d)
description:
Jobbeschreibung

Wer sind wir

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 30 High-Performern ist innerhalb von 2 Jahren von 0 auf 1 Mio. € Monatsumsatz gewachsen. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System. Dabei steht und fällt unser Wachstum mit einer Frage: Holen wir die richtigen Menschen ins Team – und erkennen wir früh genug, wenn nicht?

Was für dich drin ist

  • Du führst die gesamte Recruiting-Abteilung und baust die People-Funktion eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit auf
  • Du gibst das System vor, andere setzen es um: Dein Recruiting-Team führt aus, unser Sales & HR Analyst liefert die Zahlen
  • Du bist strategischer Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung: Wenn eine Abteilung nicht läuft, sitzt du mit am Tisch und sagst, welche Rolle und welcher Mensch fehlt
  • Echte Perspektive: Du besetzt zunehmend Führungskräfte und Schlüsselpositionen in allen Abteilungen und prägst langfristig, wie wir Führungskräfte entwickeln
  • Verdienst ab 75.000 € p. a. plus leistungsbasiertem Bonus
  • Remote möglich, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz im Office in Hockenheim
  • Investition in dein Skill-Development und 4 Team Events pro Jahr

So sieht dein Job bei uns aus

Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Recruiting-Abteilung und führst das bestehende Team. Du gibst das System vor, also Funnel, Prozesse, SOPs und Kanäle, und entscheidest, wo und wie wir suchen. Für jede Rolle baust du ein Auswahlsystem aus Anforderungsprofilen, Scorecards, strukturierten Interviews, Arbeitsproben, Probetagen, digitalen Assessments und Referenzchecks.

Du besetzt unsere Key-Rollen in Sales und Account Management in hohem Volumen. Dazu kommen zunehmend Führungskräfte, Schlüsselpositionen und Rollen, die es so vorher nicht gab. Diese gewinnst du auch über Active Sourcing und Direktansprache. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du die Rollenarchitektur: Scorecards, Stellen-VSLs und Landingpages.

Du kalibrierst alle, die bei uns Interviews führen. Du machst Fehlurteile sichtbar und bringst Gespür und Evidenz zusammen. Die Recruiting-Gespräche deines Teams reviewst du selbst und schlägst Alarm, sobald die Kandidatenqualität sinkt. Mit unserem Sales & HR Analyst verknüpfst du Probezeit und 90-Tage-Performance mit den Auswahldaten. Scheitern Probezeiten oder bleiben Hires hinter den Erwartungen, passt du die Kriterien an. Du sorgst außerdem dafür, dass Bewerber gut über uns sprechen, auch nach einer Absage. Wenn es zählt, bist du vor Ort: bei Probetagen, Starttagen und Quarterly Meetings.

Gemessen wirst du nicht daran, wie viele Menschen du einstellst, sondern daran, wie gut sie sind:

  • Probezeit-Bestehensquote und 90-Tage-Performance deiner Hires
  • Trefferquote deiner Auswahlbewertungen

title: Senior HVDC Cable Engineer – Manufacturing & Quality (Offshore Grid Connection, Germany)
description:
Location: Approx. 70% remote, 25% on site in Berlin, 5% travel to cable manufacturing and test sites in Europe
Start: 1 December 2026
Duration: Until 30 November 2028, extension possible
Workload: 440 days in total, approx. 220 days per year
Contract: Freelance

About the role

T.I.S. GmbH is looking for a Senior Cable Manufacturing & Quality Engineer for a 2 GW HVDC offshore grid connection (±525 kV) in the German North Sea. You will work on the owner’s side for a German transmission system operator and assess the series production of the HVDC cable systems for the LanWin3 2GW project. Your assessments cover the manufacturing, testing and documentation processes of the cable supplier and its subcontractors, and are the basis for the client’s technical decisions, along with a close coordination with the LanWin2 Project.

Your tasks

  • Type test phase

    • Review and document compliance with the project’s technical and quality requirements during the type test of the cable systems

    • Document deviations with their technical impact, risks and recommended follow-up actions

    • Analyse quality incidents and deviation reports: check the root cause analysis, assess the proposed corrective and preventive actions, and track their status and effectiveness

    • Classify non-conformities by cable system, technical discipline, quality impact and priority, and propose the review steps and disciplines to involve

    • Maintain the NC and action register

    • Prepare the technical input for quality meetings: open deviations, assessment status, risks and decisions required

  • Production and quality follow-up

    • Record and assess the production progress of the cable systems against the production and quality records provided

    • Document deviations from the planned manufacturing status and their impact on quality and schedule

    • Prepare periodic quality and production status reports and a final report, covering production status, new, open and closed NCs, corrective and preventive actions, outstanding evidence and test decisions, and recommendations for the client

What you bring

  • Technical degree or equivalent qualification in electrical engineering, high-voltage engineering, materials engineering or cable technology

  • Experience on at least one HVDC cable project, or an energy infrastructure project comparable in voltage level, manufacturing complexity and quality requirements

  • Proven knowledge of the manufacture and quality assurance of high-voltage or HVDC cable systems

title: Praktikant für Nachhaltiges Investment (m/w/d)
description:
Du bist auf der Suche nach einer Stelle mit Sinn und Zukunft? Deine Arbeit muss mit deinen Werten in Einklang stehen? Du willst langfristig eigenverantwortlich handeln und Kunden betreuen, die ihre Werte auch in ihrer Geldanlage wiederfinden möchten? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Mein Name ist Philipp Achenbach. Seit 2017 baue ich ­zusammen mit ­meinem Team und verschiedenen Universitäten eine der führenden Marken im Bereich ­Nachhaltiges Investment auf. Unser Daily Business ist es, die Welt zu einem besseren Ort zu machen. Um einen noch größeren Beitrag leisten zu können, brauchen wir dich!

Warum wir das tun

Wir sind uns der großen Verantwortung bewusst, die das Thema Geldanlage mit sich bringt. Deshalb setzen wir ein wichtiges Statement: Die Art und Weise sämtlicher Inves­titionen hat Auswirkungen auf die ­Zukunft unseres Planeten, des Klimas und ­folglich auf uns Menschen.

Jeder Einzelne kann mit der Wahl seiner Geldanlage einen positiven Einfluss darauf ausüben.

Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt bei der Vor- und Nachbereitung unserer Vorträge und Podcasts
  • Du erstellst für Privatkunden maßgeschneiderte Geldanlageportfolios
  • Du nimmst aktiv an Kundenterminen teil und unterstützt das Team bei der Beratung
  • Du erledigst die Vor- und Nachbereitung von Kundenterminen
  • Du erweiterst dein Wissen kontinuierlich, zum Beispiel durch unsere regelmäßigen Online Schulungen

Qualifikation

  • mindestens verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse
  • Laufendes Studium der Sozial-, Geisteswissenschaften oder BWL (oder ähnliches)
  • Da teile der Arbeit remote stattfindet können, benötigst du einen PC oder ein Notebook

Diese Stelle ist ideal für dich, wenn:

  • Du Menschen aktiv dabei unterstützen möchtest, einen positiven Beitrag zu leisten
  • Du auf der Suche nach einer Tätigkeit bist, die dich langfristig erfüllt und in der Du Dir auch eine Zusammenarbeit über das Studium hinaus vorstellen kannst
  • Du dafür brennst, den menschlichen CO2-Abdruck zu reduzieren
  • Du dich für die Erhaltung des menschlichen Lebensraumes einsetzen möchtest

Benefits

  • Du wirkst an abwechslungsreichen Projekten in verschiedenen Bereichen mit (Online-Marketing, Ausbildungkonzeption, Entwicklung und Optimierung von Kundenberatungsprozessen)
  • Du arbeitest in einem großen Wachstumsmarkt mit langfristiger Perspektive

title: RACF-Spezialist/ Mainframe Administrator (m/w/d)

Das bieten wir Dir

Deine Ideen. Deine Entwicklung. Unsere gemeinsame Zukunft.

Bei uns erwarten Dich nicht nur spannende Technologien, sondern auch die Freiräume, um eigene Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln.

title: Music Community Ambassador | First Chair Programme
description:
Help shape the future of music teaching in London

Are you part of London’s music community and passionate about teaching? Join First Chair, Matchspace Music’s founding ambassador programme, and help bring Europe’s leading platform for music educators to musicians across London.

We’re selecting six musicians to help launch Matchspace Music in the UK. You’ll connect with fellow musicians across the city, share what you’re hearing on the ground, and help us understand what independent music teachers need to build and grow their teaching practice.

You won’t be handed a script to promote. You’ll help shape how we arrive in London, from the very first week.

About Matchspace Music

Matchspace Music is Europe’s leading platform for music educators. We help independent music teachers build a professional online presence, get discovered by students, manage their lesson offers and get paid, all in one place.

Founded in Switzerland in 2020, we are home to more than 2,000 qualified teachers across over 100 instruments, with more than 2,100 international teachers registered ahead of our launch. We’re now bringing this to the UK, starting with London.

What you’ll do

As a First Chair ambassador, you’ll:

  • Introduce Matchspace Music to musicians in your peer networks.

  • Start conversations about teaching and the challenges of building an independent teaching practice.

  • Share feedback from your community with the Matchspace Music team.

  • Contribute your own perspective to help shape our UK launch.

  • Work with the team to develop an approach that feels relevant and authentic to London’s music community.

This is a six-month freelance engagement, working remotely for four hours per week, starting immediately. Hours can be planned around your studies or other commitments.

What you’ll bring

We’d like to hear from musicians who:

  • Are actively connected to London’s music community.

  • Care about music teaching and want to help improve how it works.

  • Enjoy meeting people and feel comfortable starting conversations.

  • Can share thoughtful, constructive feedback.

  • Want to help shape how we launch in London.

  • Can commit four hours per week for six months.

A student or recent graduate of a London conservatoire, we’re starting conversations at RAM, RCM, Guildhall and Trinity Laban, and welcome ambitious musicians from across the city, in any discipline: strings, piano, voice, jazz, composition and beyond.

What you’ll get

  • Paid participation: £25 per hour.

  • Flexible scheduling around your studies or other commitments.

  • Direct access to the founder and opportunities to contribute to product discussions.</

title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Measurement
description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

 


Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe.

You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on.


What You'll Do
  • Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented.
  • Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation.
  • Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Advertising solutions
description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

The Product, Engineering & Data teams are Voodoo's central tech hub. We build innovative tech products that allow us to stay ahead of the game in the mobile industry.

Part of our focus is to provide a state of the art growth-engine to distribute and scale our apps & games. By joining the team, you will take part in this journey of designing and building long-term products which help our business teams in delivering values to millions of future users!

Some examples of our products include our B2B platform used by hundreds of studios around the world to ideate and test their game prototypes, as well as an automated bidding platform that predicts the full value users will generate using state of the art ML algorithms.

Role

As the Product Manager - Advertising Solutions, you will play a crucial role in the growth and success of our direct advertising capabilities. Your primary focus will be to optimize and expand our ad solutions, driving revenue while maintaining a seamless experience for our players and advertisers. You will be responsible for growing our mobile gaming vertical from the end-to-end strategy to the development and execution, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to ensure we meet our business goals.

Role is based in our Paris headquarters with 1-2 remote days per week possible.

  • Drive  and own product vision and roadmap, guide feature prioritization and scope, in concert with cross functional teams.

  • Sie übernehmen die Federführung von Projekten in der Problemanalyse sowie Nachverfolgung von Eskalationen.
  • Außerdem unterstützen Sie als 3rd-Level-Support die Kollegen/innen vom 1st- & 2nd-Level-Support beim Troubleshooting unserer Kundennetzwerke und stellen damit den reibungslosen Betrieb, das Management und die Administration im Rahmen von SLAs sicher.
  • Sie übernehmen Projektverantwortung in der Presales-Phase, insbesondere bei Aufnahme und Evaluierung der Kundenanforderungen.
  • Sie leiten Workshops und präsentieren unsere Lösungen selbstbewusst vor Ort oder per Webex bei unseren nationalen und internationalen Kunden.
  • Sie halten sich up-to-date bei innovativen neuen Netzwerktechnologien und evaluieren und bewerten die für einen Einsatz in unseren Kundenlösungen.
  • Nach erfolgreichem Onboarding arbeiten Sie aktiv im rollierenden On-Call-System mit.

Qualifikation

  • Studium der Bereiche Informatik, Nachrichtentechnik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung, idealerweise im Carrier-Umfeld
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Cisco-Produktpalette und Zertifizierung (z.B. CCNA, CCNP)
  • Tiefgehende Kenntnisse rund um Routing, Switching, Troubleshooting, VPN, MPLS, IPSec, Netzwerk Security, Ethernet und Netzwerkdienste zählen Sie zu Ihren Stärken
  • Idealerweise Kenntnisse in SDWAN und SASE
  • Annähernd muttersprachliche Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Sie können in beiden Sprachen Kunden und Partner anleiten.
  • Fähigkeit, herausfordernde und komplexe technische Probleme und Lösungen zu erklären
  • Interesse, sich eigenständig neue Markt- und Technologiekenntnisse anzueignen

Benefits

  • Innovative ICT-Technologien und ein Cisco-Lab für Lösungsdesign und Weiterbildung
  • Eine moderne, kreative und flexible Arbeitsumgebung
  • Feedback, Trainings, Coachings zu Ihrer individuellen fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Access zu Trainingtools und -dokumentationen sowie technisches Sparring und Knowledge Transfer mit dem Engineerin

Growth at United Media

The world's most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, lan

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Lead Product Designer

📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

💰 £70k-£90k (negotiable)

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer - the most senior individual contributor for design within a product domain. This is predominantly an IC role: you'll set the design bar for an entire domain through the quality of your own work, the patterns you contribute, and the way you raise the designers around you. We're flexible on this for the right person, if you've got management experience, or want to line-manage one or two designers alongside the IC work, let's talk.

We want someone who is tired of the "feature factory" grind, who is past needing to be told what's worth working on, and who is ready to set the design direction for a domain in one of the most exciting PropTech companies in the UK.

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. Lead Product Designers drive roadmap conversations alongside their product and engineering counterparts, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L6 Lead Product Designer at Street Group

  • Own the design vision and execution for a product domain. Translate strategic direction into the most ambiguous, cross-cutting, or strategically important pieces of design work.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like in your area.

  • Own the cross-cutting design problems: patterns across multiple features, flows across multiple surfaces, the coherence of the domain's experience as a whole.

title: Accountmanager in Auction Business - Hauts-de-France (gn)
description:
For this position we source for our sister company Troostwijk.

About us

Troostwijk & the TBAuctions group are part of one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support.

What your day-to-day work will involve

As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business.

The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market.

You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships.

What this means in practice

  • Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market.
  • Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust.
  • Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations.
  • Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers.
  • Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps.
  • Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion.
  • Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools.
  • Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams.
What matters in this role

We are looking for someone who enjoys building a market rather than only maintaining an existing portfolio. You should be comfortable creating your own pipeline, speaking confidently with business owners, handling rejection and staying focused until opportunities move forward.

What you should bring

  • Proven experience in sales, business development or new-business acquisition.
  • Experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment with measurable commercial results.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, closing and relationship-building skills.
  • Autonomy, commercial drive, persistence and a results-oriented approach.
  • Willingness to travel regularly and a valid Category B driving licence.
  • French as a native language and the ability to work in English.

A perfect CV is less important than your ability to create relationships, develop a territory and turn commercial opportunities into long-term seller business.

What we offer

Autonomy with professional support

LesMills BODYPUMP, M.A.X., RIDE, TONE , GRIT, ZUMBA, H.I.I.T., PILATES, BODYATTACK, BODYCOMBAT, YOGAFLOW/POWERYOGA, STEP.

title: Head of Support (m/f/d) – Fully Remote
description:
Location: fully remote, work from anywhere

About what. AG

what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. We build websites, e-commerce and growth marketing for Swiss SMEs — and we’re pushing hard into AI-driven delivery, from our own Support Agent to our what. growth product. We’re a small, senior, remote team that likes to work smart and automate the repetitive parts.

About the role

Support has grown into one of our core services — service-agreement clients, our AI Support Agent, and on-demand project management. We’re looking for one person to own it end-to-end: the vision, the processes, the quality, the team and the commercials — and to push how far we can take AI in support. You turn a growing, multi-part operation into one well-led, measurable, continuously improving service.

How we work

You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class support to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we’re AI-first: we automate the repetitive parts and use AI as a core tool every day, so the team can focus on judgement and quality.


What you’ll do

  • Own Support end-to-end — set the vision, priorities and best practices, and give the function clear direction.

  • Run and level up our processes and AI — continuously improve all support processes, including our AI Support Agent; keep them documented, train the team, own security & compliance.
